name: Primeval Awareness
description: Use your action and spend a ranger spell slot. You sense whether undead, fiends, fey, elementals, dragons, celestials or aberrations are present within 1 mile (6 miles in your favored terrain). The sense lasts 1 minute per level of the slot.
You learn only whether they are there, not their location or number.

name: Hide in Plain Sight
description: Spend 1 minute making camouflage from mud, dirt, plants, soot and similar materials you have on hand.

Then press against a solid surface (tree, wall) at least as large as you. While you stay there without moving, taking actions or reactions, you get +10 to Dexterity (Stealth) checks. Moving or acting breaks it, and you must camouflage again.

name: Vanish
description: Hide as a bonus action.
Only magic can track you, unless you choose to leave a trail.

name: Foe Slayer
description: Once per turn, when you attack one of your favored enemies, add your Wisdom modifier to either the attack roll or the damage roll.
You can decide after seeing the roll, as long as the roll's effects are not yet applied.

name: Colossus Slayer
trigger: You hit a wounded creature with a weapon attack
description: Once per turn, a weapon hit on a creature that is below its maximum hit points adds 1d8 damage.

name: Giant Killer
trigger: A Large or larger creature within 5 ft attacks you
description: When a Large or bigger creature within 5 ft attacks you, hit or miss, you may answer with an attack against it right after, if you can see it.

name: Horde Breaker
description: Once per turn when you make a weapon attack, you get one more attack with the same weapon on a different creature. It must be within 5 ft of the first target and within your weapon's range.

name: Escape the Horde
description: Opportunity attacks against you have disadvantage.

name: Multiattack Defense
description: After a creature hits you, you gain +4 AC against its later attacks for the rest of that turn.

name: Steel Will
description: You have advantage on saves against being frightened.

name: Volley
description: Choose a spot in view that lies inside your weapon's range. Shoot every creature within 10 ft of that spot, rolling a separate attack for each target and spending ammunition on each as usual.

name: Whirlwind Attack
description: Make a melee attack against every creature within 5 ft of you, each with its own attack roll.

name: Evasion
description: On a Dexterity save that halves damage, you take none if you pass and half if you fail.

name: Stand Against the Tide
trigger: A hostile creature misses you with a melee attack
description: A hostile creature misses you with a melee attack: spend your reaction to make it redo that same attack on a different creature you pick (not itself).

name: Uncanny Dodge
trigger: An attacker you can see hits you
description: When an attacker you can see hits you, halve that attack's damage to you.

name: Ranger's Companion
uses: Replace a dead companion in 8 hours
description: You gain a beast companion: a beast of Medium size or smaller with challenge rating 1/4 or lower (hawk, mastiff and panther are in appendix D). Add your proficiency bonus to its AC, attack and damage rolls, and proficient saves and skills.
Its hit point maximum is its normal one or 4 x your ranger level, whichever is higher. It acts on your initiative but only moves unless you command it (see Companion Commands).
With only the beast along, you move stealthily at normal pace in favored terrain. From level 15, a spell you cast on yourself can also affect the beast within 30 ft.
If it dies, bond with another willing beast over 8 hours.

name: Companion Commands
description: On your turn you can direct where the beast moves for free. Spend your action to have it Attack, Dash, Disengage, Dodge or Help. Once you have Extra Attack, you may make one weapon attack yourself when you order its Attack.
From level 11 the companion makes two attacks when ordered to Attack.

name: Exceptional Training
description: On a turn your beast doesn't attack, use a bonus action to have it Dash, Disengage, Dodge or Help on its turn.

name: Aberrations
description: Aberrations count as your favored enemy. Track them with advantage on Wisdom (Survival), and recall lore about them with advantage on Intelligence checks. You also pick up one language they speak, if they have one.
You pick another favored enemy at 6th and 14th level.

name: Two Humanoid Races
description: Instead of a creature type, you may name two humanoid races, such as gnolls and orcs. Both count as favored enemies, with the same tracking and lore advantages and one language they speak.
You pick another favored enemy at 6th and 14th level.

name: Arctic
description: Arctic is a favored terrain. Your proficiency bonus is doubled on Intelligence or Wisdom checks about it when you use a skill you are proficient in.

Traveling there for an hour or more: difficult terrain does not slow your group, only magic can get it lost, you stay alert while busy, you can sneak at a normal pace when alone, you find twice the food when foraging, and tracking reveals exact numbers, sizes and age.
You pick more favored terrain at 6th and 10th level.
